one_line: Nvidia navigates leadership turbulence and regulatory scrutiny, while governments and companies worldwide announce new AI infrastructure, funding, and safety initiatives.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and regulatory scrutiny
themes.text: Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia's CEO following lobbying by political and tech allies, though the company continues to face federal investigations, potential credit downgrades, and scrutiny over chip smuggling allegations and financing models.

themes.title: Global funding and infrastructure developments
themes.text: Global funding initiatives and regulatory measures emerge as the European Union plans a €50 billion tech equity fund, new US chip curbs stall data center loans, and ElevenLabs targets a $33 billion valuation.

themes.text: OpenAI released a preprint claiming the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4, while researchers introduced Crucible Bench to evaluate LLM agents in chemistry research.
